name: Maneater
source:
When the world is overrun by demons, you decide to be a responsible little citizen and stay home. But your girlfriend seems to have other plans. Selfish plans.

[From [url=https://liminace.itch.io/maneater]itch.io[/url]]

当世界被恶魔占领时，你决定做一个负责任的小公民并呆在家里。但你女朋友似乎另有打算。自私的计划。

[来自[url=https://liminace.itch.io/maneater]itch.io[/url]]
